q.en: When is the woman's birthday?

lines.s: 外面風好大，你要出去嗎？
lines.zh: 外面風好大，你要出去嗎？
lines.en: It's very windy — are you going out?
No, I'll rest at home.

q.en: What will the man do?

lines.s: 這個房間一個月多少錢？
lines.zh: 這個房間一個月多少錢？
lines.en: How much is this room a month?
Eight thousand; water and electricity are extra.

q.en: How much is the room a month?

lines.en: Can your older brother speak Japanese?
Yes, he lived in Tokyo for two years.

q.s: 男的哥哥在東京住了多久？
q.zh: 男的哥哥在東京住了多久？
q.en: How long did his brother live in Tokyo?

lines.en: You look tired — what's wrong?

lines.s: 昨天晚上我準備考試，只睡了四個小時。
lines.zh: 昨天晚上我準備考試，只睡了四個小時。
lines.en: I was preparing for an exam last night and slept only four hours.

q.s: 女的昨天晚上睡了幾個小時？
q.zh: 女的昨天晚上睡了幾個小時？
q.en: How many hours did she sleep?
